extraFacts.fact: NPSM is a straight (parallel) pipe thread under ASME B1.20.1 and does not seal on the thread; NPTF (Dryseal) under ASME B1.20.3 is a taper thread that seals on the thread.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1 and ASME B1.20.3 scopes

extraFacts.fact: SAE J1926 / ISO 11926 covers straight-thread O-ring boss (ORB) ports, which seal on an O-ring under the hex, not on the thread.
Hose and fitting dash sizes count sixteenths of an inch: -3 is 3/16 inch, -4 is 1/4 inch, -6 is 3/8 inch, -8 is 1/2 inch, -12 is 3/4 inch, -16 is 1 inch and -20 is 1-1/4 inch.
extraFacts.source: SAE J514 / ISO 8434 dash size convention; row data of this family

extraFacts.fact: Zinc plating vaporises at the weld, so on a zinc-plated part the coating is cleared from the weld zone and the area is ventilated.
extraFacts.source: American Welding Society safety and health fact sheets on welding zinc-coated steel
